READ ME: This file is the ANSWER KEY for ScholarFitAccuracyTest. It was written by working each case out by hand from the rules,
not by running the code and copying what it said. The test then runs the real engine over every applicant and every listing
and fails wherever the engine disagrees with this file.
If you disagree with an entry here, that is a product decision to talk about - change the entry, and the test will tell us
what the engine has to change to match. If the engine disagrees with an entry you agree with, the engine has a bug.
Each listing has one letter per applicant, in the order A1 to A11:
E = eligible (meets every rule it states, or states none)
N = needs information (nothing certainly fails, but the profile has not said something the listing asks about)
The applicants and listings themselves are in applicants.json and listings.json beside this file.
Changed on purpose on 13 Oct 2026: an O-Level student is refused an Undergraduate award unless the listing says it
accepts O-Level holders (A3 against L04, L07, L10-L16, L18-L20). Before that rule A3 was eligible or asked for information.
Added the same day for the 'Who is it open to?' rules: applicant A12 (a graduate with a field to study next) and listings
L22-L25 (a diploma award a degree-only leaver should not match, a Masters to study abroad open to a field, a listing open
to all programmes on purpose, and one that takes O-Level holders). L01-L21 are kept as listings posted before the question
was asked, so they also show that old listings keep working.
